title: Run ids are compared as text, so a changed repository prefix breaks the harvest and QA bookmarks
story: The harvest and QA skills used to pick new run reports by sorting their names as text, so a project whose name changed spelling between runs saw old notes forever or lost new ones. They now sort by the date and time inside each run id.
no_qa_reason: Skill wording only; nothing a user drives on its own, and a suite check covers the wording.
